description:
On main (after the defk-6ag merge), MIX_ENV=test mix dialyzer reports 1 error: lib/defk/inline_size.ex:83:17 call_without_opaque (Defk.InlineSize.visit/4 called with {%MapSet{map: %{}}, []} where {MapSet.t(), _} with opaque subterms is expected). Cause not investigated. mix ci stops there, so ex_dna, reach.check and usage_rules.sync --check never run. Found while landing defk-mob.

Done when: MIX_ENV=test mix dialyzer reports 0 errors and mix ci passes on main.
title: mix ci fails at dialyzer: call_without_opaque in lib/defk/inline_size.ex:83
